summary: Northbridge AI: Request audit trail of Hosted rollout changes (create/update/pause/rollback) for compliance
description:
Issue summary
Northbridge AI asked how they can obtain an audit trail of changes to Hosted canary rollouts (who changed what and when), including create/update of traffic split percentages and pause/rollback actions. They need this for internal compliance controls (SOC2 change management) and want the logs exportable to their SIEM.

Customer request / requirements
- Record: create rollout, edit rollout schedule/weights, edit guardrails, pause rollout, rollback to baseline.
- Include: actor identity, timestamp, route identifier, baseline/candidate model+version, before/after diff.
- Retention/export: ability to forward to SIEM (or download) for audit evidence.

Impact
- Blocking their internal change management sign-off for enabling percentage-based rollouts broadly.
- They can proceed with limited testing, but need an audit trail before expanding usage.

Current product behavior (as of today)
- Console shows an Activity timeline for rollout changes (UI-level history) but it is not currently available as an exportable, compliance-grade audit log feed.
- Organization-level audit logs do not yet include full Hosted rollout policy change events in the customer-facing export.

What we provided (interim workaround)
1) Console evidence package (manual):
   - Use the rollout Activity timeline to capture screenshots of changes (including actor + timestamp).
   - For each change window, capture the effective routing preview state before/after.
2) Support-assisted audit extract (temporary):
   - Support can provide a point-in-time change history extract for a specific route and date range (actor, timestamp, before/after JSON) from internal control-plane change records.
   - Note: This is provided as best-effort evidence and not a continuous export stream.

Planned / in-progress solution
- We shared our internal spec for rollout audit events and confirmed this is planned as part of Hosted canary rollout workflow GA.
- Event types planned: rollout.policy.created / updated / paused / rolled_back, including structured diffs and actor attribution.
- Export considerations: align with existing audit log export mechanism (customer SIEM forwarding) and retention policy.

Next steps
- Customer to confirm which routes and date range they need for the interim audit extract.
- Support to loop in Security (Kevin Osei / Marcus Lin) if the customer needs a formal statement on current limitations + planned GA timeline.
comments: 2024-10-03 09:18 (Dev Patel, Support) — Intake from customer call: they want an audit trail for any canary rollout changes (weights/guardrails/pause/rollback). They specifically asked for ‘who changed traffic split to 50% at 2:14pm’ type evidence and whether it can be forwarded to Splunk.

2024-10-03 11:02 (Owen Phillips, Support) — Asked internally in #eng-security for current status of rollout-specific audit events and whether anything is already in the standard audit export. Also requested guidance on what we can share as a workaround.

2024-10-03 13:40 (Kevin Osei, Security) — Confirmed: rollout policy change events are specified but not fully available in the customer-facing audit export yet. Pointed to the internal spec: sources/confluence/security-and-compliance/audit-logging/rollout-policy-change-audit-events.json. Recommended: (a) manual evidence via Console activity timeline + screenshots; (b) support-provided extract for a defined window if needed for audit evidence.

2024-10-04 10:07 (Owen Phillips, Support) — Replied to customer with: current state, the interim options, and that full exportable audit events are part of GA readiness for Hosted rollouts. Offered to provide an interim ‘change history’ CSV for a specific route/date range and asked for their preferred identifiers (account + route slug) and timeframe.

2024-10-07 16:22 (Dev Patel, Support) — Customer provided details: account ‘northbridge-prod’, routes: /v1/chat (primary), /v1/embeddings (secondary). Timeframe: last 14 days. They want actor identity mapped to SSO email if possible.

2024-10-08 12:55 (Owen Phillips, Support) — Provided interim extract to customer via secure share (route, timestamp, actor, action, before/after weights + baseline/candidate). Noted limitation: actor identity is recorded as Redwood user/org member; mapping to SSO email depends on how the user was created (we included the available email field where present).

2024-10-10 09:30 (Owen Phillips, Support) — Customer confirmed this unblocks their immediate audit evidence request. Marking ticket Resolved; customer asked to be notified when the continuous audit export is GA. Added note to follow up once rollout audit event export is customer-available.
resolution: Provided interim, support-assisted audit history extract for requested routes/timeframe and shared the internal rollout audit event spec. Customer confirmed it unblocks their immediate compliance evidence need; awaiting GA availability of continuous/exportable rollout audit events for SIEM forwarding.
customer_facing_response: Today, Hosted rollout changes are visible in the Console rollout Activity timeline, but the continuous/exportable audit-log feed for rollout policy changes is still in progress. As an interim workaround, we can (1) use the Activity timeline as evidence (screenshots + before/after routing preview) and/or (2) provide a support-assisted change history extract for a specific route and date range (actor, timestamp, action, before/after). We’ve shared our rollout audit event specification and will notify you as soon as the exportable audit events are available as part of the Hosted rollouts GA readiness work.
